notes: Model pilot (sonnet arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole reads the held pole bonsai1/L12/N586- (zeroing the anchor removes 1.00 of this pole's activation), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Sonnet 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: My probes (NEJM, PNAS, BPJ, Lancet) all stayed under 0.11 though the packet's top examples are 'Economic Journal', 'Postgraduate Medical Journal' and the bmj DOI piece. So the label narrows to those, and quiet items use other journals, books and 'journal' in prose. Expect a possible fail.
